Name: Main Controller
Description: Microcontroller running GRBL firmware to control CNC axes and spindle.

Name: Main 24V Power Supply
Description: Provides 24V DC power for stepper motors and spindle driver.

Name: 24V to 5V Converter
Description: Steps down 24V to 5V for the ESP32 and stepper driver logic.

Name: X-Axis Stepper Driver
Description: Controls the X-axis NEMA 17 stepper motor.

Name: Y-Axis Stepper Driver
Description: Controls the Y-axis NEMA 17 stepper motor.

Name: Z-Axis Stepper Driver
Description: Controls the Z-axis NEMA 17 stepper motor.

Name: X-Axis Stepper Motor
Description: Provides motion for the X-axis.

Name: Y-Axis Stepper Motor
Description: Provides motion for the Y-axis.

Name: Z-Axis Stepper Motor
Description: Provides motion for the Z-axis.

Name: Spindle Motor Driver
Description: Controls the speed and on/off state of the DC spindle motor using a PWM signal.

Name: Spindle Motor
Description: The tool head responsible for material removal.

Name: X-Axis End-stop
Description: Detects the physical limit of the X-axis travel.

Name: Y-Axis End-stop
Description: Detects the physical limit of the Y-axis travel.

Name: Z-Axis End-stop
Description: Detects the physical limit of the Z-axis travel.

Name: Base Frame X (Front/Back)
Description: Forms the front and back of the machine's base frame.

Name: Base Frame Y (Sides)
Description: Forms the sides of the machine's base frame.

Name: Y-Axis Gantry Beam
Description: Main beam for the Y-axis gantry, spanning across the base.

Name: Z-Axis Vertical Extrusions
Description: Vertical extrusions for the Z-axis linear motion.

Name: X-Axis Lead Screw
Description: Provides linear motion for the X-axis.

Name: Y-Axis Lead Screw
Description: Provides linear motion for the Y-axis.

Name: Z-Axis Lead Screw
Description: Provides linear motion for the Z-axis.

Name: X-Axis Linear Rods
Description: Guide rails for X-axis movement.

Name: Y-Axis Linear Rods
Description: Guide rails for Y-axis movement.

Name: Z-Axis Linear Rods
Description: Guide rails for Z-axis movement.

Name: LM8UU Linear Bearings
Description: Allow smooth sliding motion on 8mm linear rods.

Name: Shaft Couplers (5x8mm)
Description: Connects NEMA 17 motor shafts (5mm) to T8 lead screws (8mm).

Name: KP08 Pillow Block Bearings
Description: Supports the ends of the T8 lead screws.

Name: Spoilboard
Description: Sacrificial work surface for material mounting.

Name: M5 T-Nuts
Description: Used to fasten components to aluminum extrusions.

Name: M5 Screws (various lengths)
Description: Fasteners for assembling the aluminum frame and mounting components.

Name: M3 Screws (various lengths)
Description: Fasteners for mounting stepper motors, drivers, and other small electrical components.

Name: 90-Degree Corner Brackets
Description: Reinforces connections between aluminum extrusions.

Name: X-Axis Motor Mount
Description: Mounts the X-axis stepper motor to the frame.

Name: Y-Axis Motor Mount
Description: Mounts the Y-axis stepper motor to the frame.

Name: Z-Axis Motor Mount
Description: Mounts the Z-axis stepper motor to the Z-axis carriage.

Name: X-Axis Lead Screw Nut Block
Description: Holds the T8 lead screw nut for X-axis motion.

Name: Y-Axis Lead Screw Nut Block
Description: Holds the T8 lead screw nut for Y-axis motion.

Name: Z-Axis Lead Screw Nut Block
Description: Holds the T8 lead screw nut for Z-axis motion.

Name: Spindle Mount (52mm)
Description: Securely holds the 52mm diameter spindle motor.

Name: Tool Holder Rack
Description: Rack to store ER11 collets and milling bits.

Name: X-Axis End-stop Mount
Description: Mounts the X-axis limit switch to the frame.

Name: Y-Axis End-stop Mount
Description: Mounts the Y-axis limit switch to the frame.

Name: Z-Axis End-stop Mount
Description: Mounts the Z-axis limit switch to the Z-axis.

Name: X-Axis Carriage Plate
Description: Connects X-axis linear bearings and lead screw nut to the Z-axis assembly.

Name: Y-Axis Gantry Plates
Description: Connects Y-axis linear bearings and lead screw nut to the Y-axis gantry beam.

Name: Z-Axis Carriage Plate
Description: Connects Z-axis linear bearings and lead screw nut to the spindle mount.

Name: Controller Enclosure
Description: Encloses the ESP32 and stepper drivers.
